elaine_cs: quick heads-up — Helix Labs private deploy dry-run hit three blockers: outbound allowlist, KMS permissions, and CloudTrail forwarding. filing notes here so we can align before cutover :clipboard:
omar_net: can you share the exact failure from the dry-run? logs or error msg?
elaine_cs: network team saw hits failing with "connection refused" to our telemetry endpoint and their infra team told us the fw rule used an internal supernet and no specific external CIDR. snippet they applied:
```
# applied by customer
resource "azurerm_network_security_rule" "egress" {
  name                       = "allow-telemetry"
  direction                  = "Outbound"
  access                     = "Allow"
  destination_address_prefix = "10.0.0.0/8"  # wrong, internal-only
  destination_port_range     = "443"
  protocol                   = "Tcp"
}
```
omar_net: ah that explains overlap. we should provide a recommended public netblock + an explicit note for using a private VPC endpoint when customers want no egress. I'll draft a sample terraform and a one-line iptables verify.
lucas_sec: KMS stuff: their service role has an attached managed policy permitting `kms:*` — flagged by security. also CloudTrail forwarding failed with AccessDenied when writing to central bucket (object lock + bucket policy missing cross-account write grant). runbook currently says "enable CloudTrail" but doesn't show cross-account policy example.
tasha_eng: proposed runbook edits (short):
- Networking: recommend telemetry CIDR `203.0.113.0/24` (example), add VPC endpoint snippet and `curl` verify for endpoint.
- IAM/KMS: replace `kms:*` sample with least-priv policy and an inline note about `kms:CreateGrant` when using temporary creds. include rotation options (quarterly default, note monthly needs rewrap & table rebuild).
- Audit logs: add cross-account S3 policy + object-lock checklist (encryption, ACLs, block public access).
omar_net: terraform VPC endpoint snippet (drop-in):
```
resource "aws_vpc_endpoint" "telemetry" {
  vpc_id            = var.vpc_id
  service_name      = "com.amazonaws.us-west-2.s3"
  route_table_ids   = var.route_tables
  private_dns_enabled = true
}
# verify with: curl -v https://telemetry.internal.example/health --resolve "telemetry.internal.example:443:10.0.2.5"
```
lucas_sec: minimal KMS policy example to put in runbook:
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Sid": "AllowAppToEncryptDecrypt",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:Encrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey*"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:987654321098:key/abcd-ef01-2345"
    }
  ]
}
```
lucas_sec: note: if customer requests monthly rotation we must schedule a maintenance window for rewrap and run a quick data-store integrity check. mark as potential renewal risk if they insist on monthly without commit window.
elaine_cs: audit bucket sample policy I requested from infra (S3 central-account id: 111122223333):
```
{
  "Version":"2012-10-17",
  "Statement":[
    {
      "Effect":"Allow",
      "Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::987654321098:root"},
      "Action":["s3:PutObject","s3:PutObjectAcl"],
      "Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::redwood-audit-bucket/*"
    }
  ]
}
```
prereqs: bucket must have default SSE (AES256 or aws:kms), Object Lock enabled with retention >= 1 year, and block public access on. common failure is encryption mismatch or missing PutObjectAcl.
ops-bot: Checklist updated: added tasks "Telemetry CIDR + VPC endpoint", "KMS least-priv example", "CloudTrail cross-account policy + object-lock". See /runbooks/helix-priv-deploy-draft.
elaine_cs: next steps: 1) Omar & Tasha to add the snippets to runbook today 2) Lucas to prepare the minimal KMS policy + rotation note 3) I'll schedule a 30m sync with Helix infra (please join). Also flagging potential renewal risk if monthly rotation becomes a hard requirement.
omar_net: I can update the runbook this afternoon and post a PR.
lucas_sec: I'll add the security rationale and the grant note.
tasha_eng: available for sync tomorrow 09:00 PT or 11:30 PT.
elaine_cs: proposing tomorrow 09:00 PT — sending invite to Helix infra and account exec. agenda: confirm telemetry CIDR or VPC endpoint, finalize KMS policy + rotation cadence, validate CloudTrail cross-account plumbing, agree cutover checklist & post-dry-run signoff.
elaine_cs: thanks team — once runbook edits merged we'll run a second dry-run and update renewal-risk status accordingly :thumbsup:
